name: Integrated Solar
old_description: Solar photovoltaic (PV) technology converts the sun's energy into electricity. Solar modules or “panels” can be mounted on a roof, the side of a building, or on a ground rack.
about:
Integrated Solar Applications Corp. is based in Brattleboro, Vermont. The company is celebrating its 50th anniversary, marking over five decades in the renewable energy business. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm designs and installs solar photovoltaic arrays, geothermal heat-pump systems, air-source heat pumps, and battery energy storage for residential, commercial, municipal, and school clients. It also develops community solar projects and offers integrated system designs that combine multiple renewable technologies. The company operates as an Efficiency Vermont certified member and partners with EastRise Credit Union to provide no-money-down financing through the Heat Saver Loan and VGreen Project Loan programs.

Its customer base spans homeowners, small and large businesses, municipalities, and school districts across Vermont and New Hampshire. Notable projects include a 144 kW ground-mount array in Putney that serves more than 25 residences.

Integrated Solar emphasizes a whole-systems approach, combining solar, geothermal, heat pumps, and storage to achieve net-zero energy solutions. Its long-standing presence in the region and access to utility-backed loan programs are cited as key differentiators.
